title: Provenance
description: Provenance tracking for beliefs: sources, grounding chain, and experiential basis. Per Haack's foundherentism - beliefs must be grounded in experience AND cohere with other beliefs.

sources.description: Sources from which this belief derives. At least one source required.

grounding_score.description: Haack grounding score [0,1]. Higher = more directly grounded in experience. 1.0 = direct observation. 0.0 = purely theoretical with no experiential chain.

grounding_chain.description: Chain of belief IDs from this belief to its experiential grounding. Empty for directly observed beliefs.

experiential_claims.description: References to experiential claims that ground this belief

directness.description: How directly this belief connects to experience. DIRECT = observational. ONE_HOP = inferred from observation. MULTI_HOP = longer inference chain. THEORETICAL = no direct chain.

coherence_contribution.description: How much this belief contributes to web coherence. Purely theoretical beliefs can have high coherence contribution even with low grounding.

justification_status.description: Haack justification status. WELL_JUSTIFIED = both grounded AND coherent. GROUNDED_ONLY = grounded but low coherence. COHERENT_ONLY = coherent but poorly grounded (WARNING). UNJUSTIFIED = neither.

crossword_position.description: Position in Haack's crossword metaphor - how this belief interlocks with others

supports.description: Belief IDs this belief provides evidence for (like letters in crossing words)

supported_by.description: Belief IDs that provide evidence for this belief

integration_score.description: How well integrated into the crossword (many interlocking beliefs = higher)

extraction_metadata.description: Metadata from Article Eater extraction process

extracted_from.description: Paper DOI or ID from which this was extracted

study_type.description: Study design type for empirical sources

connection_strength.description: How strongly this belief connects to that experiential claim
